name: Sparse Voxel Morphology (Dilate/Erode)
definition: Morphological operations on sparse voxel sets represented as (N, 3) integer arrays, using packed int64 keys for sorted-array lookups instead of dense grids.
summary: Sparse Voxel Morphology performs topological dilation and erosion on sparse voxel sets using sorted-array lookups, avoiding dense grid allocation to scale memory with object size.
